issue.title: Move sase-github and sase-research-artifacts to packaged macros/ under sase_macros only, after a macro-capable sase release

task_type_fields.proposal:
Finish the plugin side of the xprompt-to-macro rename in sase-github and sase-research-artifacts once a published sase release can read packaged macros:

1. `git mv` each plugin's packaged `xprompts/` directory to `macros/`.
2. Drop the legacy `sase_xprompts` entry-point group so only `sase_macros` is registered.
3. Raise each plugin's sase floor to the first published sase release that discovers `sase_macros` and packaged `macros/`.
4. Move publish smokes off `sase.xprompt.*` imports. sase-research-artifacts' publish.yml still smokes `sase.xprompt.*` against published sase, and `sase.xprompt` was deleted in sase 17c2907d3b.
5. Confirm `sase doctor` no longer emits the config.retired_xprompt_names WARN for those two groups.

Evidence: sase-1eq.11 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1 (2026-10-05). The doctor WARN currently fires for both plugins' sase_xprompts groups. This is one prerequisite in the "Remove when" condition of flag bead sase-1fj (Retire legacy_xprompt_syntax): "every maintained plugin ships macros/ under sase_macros with a sase floor that reads it".
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1eq (plan 202610/xprompts_to_macros.md, phase "plugins") deliberately kept packaged xprompts/ directories and the sase_xprompts group, because no published sase can yet read packaged macros/. Moving the plugins early would break every user on a released sase. This work is gated on a sase release, which this epic does not produce, so it is not remaining epic work.

issue.creation_reason: The macro rename left both plugins on dual entry-point groups with packaged xprompts/ directories until a released sase can read macros/. This is a hard prerequisite for retiring legacy_xprompt_syntax (sase-1fj), and nothing else tracks it.

payload.entry: RELATED (typed link blocked by sase-1gs): sase-1fj, the legacy_xprompt_syntax flag bead, lists this work in its Remove-when condition. sase-1ei (research-artifacts published-minimum smoke pins an unreleased sase) constrains which sase floor this task can raise to.
